notices.title: Steam Week in Review: Take cover, because it looks like more than half of Steam games will have an AI-disclosure by 2027-2028
notices.contentSnippet: All the interesting Steam facts for the week ending July 19.

notices.title: Xbox Game Pass Losing 2 Of its Highest-Rated Games and 6 More Titles on July 31
notices.contentSnippet: The second wave of Xbox Game Pass departures in July 2026 consists of 7 titles, including two beloved games with 90+ critic scores.

notices.title: PS5 Exclusive Astro Bot Now Runs on PC
notices.contentSnippet: Though Astro Bot is a PS5 exclusive platformer, some tech-savvy gamers have already managed to boot up the 2024 game of the year on PC.

notices.title: Masterpiece Open-World RPGs Explicitly Built To Be Played Twice
notices.contentSnippet: It's fine to finish these games once and move on, but you will appreciate them a thousand times more if you stick with them for a second playthrough.

notices.title: Pokemon Scarlet and Violet Players Can Now Easily Get 2 Super Rare Pokemon, But There's a Catch
notices.contentSnippet: Pokemon Scarlet and Violet players have a one-of-a-kind chance of getting two of the rarest Pokemon in the game, but it's not exactly for everyone.

notices.title: New Deal Gives PC Players $465 of Games for Just $15
notices.contentSnippet: PC gamers have a limited time to take advantage of a bundle deal that includes several highly-rated titles for a fraction of the original cost.

notices.title: Cliff Bleszinski says ego played a role in LawBreakers' failure: 'People are loyal to the game, but they're not necessarily loyal to the person'
notices.contentSnippet: "I wanted it to be my show, and that was the first step of my ego creeping in right there."

notices.title: What's the best summer-themed videogame track?
notices.contentSnippet: Get your ukuleles and steel pan drums at the ready.

notices.title: 'The mid-2000s was the golden era of first-person shooters': David Szymanski, creator of Dusk and Iron Lung, discusses the games on his PC
notices.contentSnippet: The New Blood dev guides us through the games in his Steam library.

notices.title: Gears of War's creator is considering returning to game development, but whatever he makes won't be PvP like his last efforts: 'Good luck to anyone in that space'
notices.contentSnippet: "Players just want to hop online with friends and shoot some stuff."

notices.title: 'GTA 6 needs this': This GTA 5 prison mod turns one of roleplay's most enduring staples into a game within a game
notices.contentSnippet: With flavours of Shawshank , this player-made masterstroke is a world unto itself.

notices.title: Grab a free Steam game full of misery and decision-making for a limited time
notices.contentSnippet: The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante seems like it lives up to its name.
